articleTitle: Main algorithm of mobile robot system based on the microcontroller Arduino
publicationTitle: 2013 XVIIIth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: In this paper main algorithms of mobile robot system are given. The proposed solution is used as a base for other projects construction.

articleTitle: Antenna synthesis according to power radiation pattern with condition of norm equality
publicationTitle: 2013 XVIIIth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: The antenna synthesis problem according to the prescribed power radiation pattern (RP) is generalized by taking into account an additional restriction on the norm of the synthesized RP. The variational approach supplemented by the Lagrange method of multipliers is applied for the formulation of problem. The modified Newton method is used for numerical solving the respective Euler equation. Numerical results are demonstrated on the example of linear antenna.

articleTitle: Recognition multifrequency microwave images of simple objects behind dielectric wall using neural networks and correlation technique
publicationTitle: 2013 XVIIIth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: Recognition of objects situated behind a dielectric wall has been implemented for real experimental data using neural networks in the form of multilayer perceptron, GRNN, PNN and RBF and correlation techniques. The objects under recognition have been metal parallelepipeds and cylinders with variation of sizes. As the result of the study, it has been found the best settings for the recognition of objects of several geometric shapes.

articleTitle: Complex polynomials representation of solutions to the antenna synthesis problem by the power pattern
publicationTitle: 2013 XVIIIth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: The nonlinear integral equation of Hammerstein type arising in the antenna synthesis problem according to the given power pattern is investigated. This equation contains the nonlinearity of the third degree in the integrant. Its solutions are presented by a real positive function (amplitude pattern) and a polynomial with complex zeros (whose phase coincides with the phase pattern). The both amplitude pattern and zeros of the polynomials are found from a set of equations, one of which is the nonlinear integral equation, and the rest (as many as twice the polynomial degree) are the transcendental ones. Numerical results for a concrete problem are described.

articleTitle: Electrodynamic characteristics of a double screen of finite thickness with coaxial-sector aperture of different geometrics
publicationTitle: 2013 XVIIIth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: The electrodynamic characteristics of a double screen of finite thickness with coaxial-sector apertures of different geometrics are investigated. The frequency dependence of the reflection coefficient of the plane wave is calculated. The Stokes parameters of the reflected wave are analyzed in dependence on the distance between the screens.

articleTitle: On the radiation of charged particle moving in a waveguide with anisotropic magneto dielectric filling
publicationTitle: 2013 XVIIIth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: The radiation of charged particle moving uniformly in the regular waveguide of arbitrary cross section loaded with anisotropic magneto dielectric medium is discussed. It is assumed that the particle moves along the oz axis of the waveguide. The wave equation, the analytical expressions of the field and of radiation energy are found.

articleTitle: Antiradar protection of bodies by surfaces with impedance and dielectric coatings
publicationTitle: 2013 XVIIIth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: The mathematical technique is developed which permits to determine the parameters of coatings providing for bodies of different shape their invisibility from the direction of one-position radar. The “invisibility” means that the scattered field, which arises when a wave radiated by the radar falls on the body, equals zero at the position where the radar is located. This condition must be satisfied for all orientations of the radar with respect to the body. The both widely used impedance and dielectric (nonmagnetic) coatings are considered. The first results related to the protection of nonplanar surfaces are presented and possible directions of further investigations in this field are pointed out.

articleTitle: Development of smart house system model based on colored Petri nets
publicationTitle: 2013 XVIIIth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: The smart house (SH) structural scheme, the general performance algorithm of the SH system, and the SH system model based on colored Petri nets, which enables exploring dynamics of the whole system as well as internal interaction of its main structural and functional subsystems at the system level design, have been developed.

articleTitle: Noise mitigation and extraction of scatters in acoustic imaging by compressed sensing
publicationTitle: 2013 XVIIIth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: In order to maintain the theoretical limit of resolution in acoustic imaging for noisy data gathered in a material examination application we propose the application of compressed sensing (CS) on the reconstructed image. CS will mitigate the effects of noise in the reconstruction process and enable the extraction of location and estimated size of scatters to enhance the initial velocity model.

articleTitle: Sound radiation from T junction of city roads
publicationTitle: 2013 XVIIIth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: The sound radiation from vehicles moving on city road with T intersection is considered. The solution of problem is found on the base of superposition of the solutions with taking into account of wind effect in acoustic field for the cases of vehicles move along straight roads and roads with the right-angle bend. The numerical analysis of traffic noise characteristics is carried out for the T junction example on Wolczańska and Wróblewskiego streets in the town of Łódź (Poland).

articleTitle: Calculation of transparent antenna with triangle
publicationTitle: 2013 XVIIIth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: The calculation method of electrical characteristics of the flat transparent antenna with metal triangle in the base is developed. The method is based on the solution of the integral equation for the current along the transparent conductive film. Ways of such antennas optimization are sown.

articleTitle: Time-harmonic interaction effects for a periodic system of coplanar cracks in 3D elastic solids
publicationTitle: 2013 XVIIIth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: The symmetric problem of time-harmonic elastic wave interaction with a periodic array of coplanar penny-shaped cracks embedded in an infinite elastic solid is numerically investigated. The problem is reduced to a boundary integral equation (BIE) for the crack-opening-displacement (COD) by means of a 3D periodic Green's function obtained in the form of exponentially-convergent Fourier integrals. A stable numerical procedure is developed for the solution of the BIE. Numerical results for the mode-I dynamic stress intensity factor (SIF) are presented and discussed to show its variation with the dimensionless wave number and the distance between the cracks.

articleTitle: Axially-symmetric excitation of conical monopole antenna
publicationTitle: 2013 XVIIIth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: The conical monopole antenna excitation is analyzed rigorously using the analytical regularization technique. The electromagnetic far-field characteristics as functions of ring source location are discussed.

articleTitle: Synthesis of antenna system of parallel cylindrical radiators according to the given amplitude directivity pattern
publicationTitle: 2013 XVIIIth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: In this article the method of antenna array synthesis according to the given amplitude directivity pattern is generalized on the case of antenna system of parallel cylindrical radiators which centers are located on one plane. It's used more precise formulation of problem which takes into account the mutual coupling of radiators. The synthesis problem is formulated as a problem of minimization of smoothing functional and is reduced to finding of voltages distribution from the system of nonlinear integral equations of Hammerstein type. The numerical results of synthesis of different types of the given amplitude directivity patterns are obtained.

articleTitle: Eigenoscillations and energy generated by nonlinear cubically polarisable layers
publicationTitle: 2013 XVIIIth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: In the frequency domain, the resonant properties of nonlinear structures are determined by the proximity of the scattering/generation frequencies of the nonlinear structures to the complex eigenfrequencies of the corresponding homogeneous linear spectral problems with the induced nonlinear permeability of the medium. Here the case of cubically polarisable layers is considered.

articleTitle: An efficient solution for the parallelization of the multilevel fast multipole algorithm
publicationTitle: 2013 XVIIIth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: In this paper, an implementation of parallel MLFMA for scattering problems is presented. MLFMA is an efficient algorithm for accelerating the calculation of matrix-vector-multiplication. Using the hybrid strategy, the parallel version can be efficiently realized on distributed memory systems. Tree construction, communication, etc., are the key techniques which are discussed in details here. Numerical results show the efficiency of the MLFMA is improved by the parallelization.

articleTitle: The Method of Auxiliary Sources for antenna synthesis problems
publicationTitle: 2013 XVIIIth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: Based on the Method of Auxiliary Sources (MAS) by means of the scattered field singularities localization antenna synthesis with given pattern directivity is considered. The antenna synthesis problem has ambiguous solution, because the same pattern at the same frequency could get with the different current distribution on certain antenna surface. But there exist unique optimal current distribution in order to get efficiently given pattern. It could be realized with minimal value of: the: currents, reactive near field and the best matched antenna to radiation. Optimal currents distribution is related to the desire pattern's scattered field singularities.

articleTitle: Recurrent expressions for modelling time reliability indices of compound electromagnetic systems
publicationTitle: 2013 XVIIIth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: A method of investigation of reliability parameters of compound systems by means of generating functions is developed taking account of aging of the system's output elements. Main time reliability indices of compound electromagnetic systems are examined in this paper. Expressions for the average duration of the system's stay in each of its states and the average duration of the system's stay in the prescribed availability condition are worked out in cases when the lifetime of ageing output elements is circumscribed by the Weibull distribution.

articleTitle: The microstrip resonator for measurement of dielectric constant
publicationTitle: 2013 XVIIIth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: The electromagnetic sensor for measure of dielectric constant of flat objects and objects with one-way access is developed. The description of the original design of microstrip resonator is given. The calculation procedure and the description of the experiment are presented. An adequate measurement of the dielectric constant objects of different nature is received.

articleTitle: Electrodynamic characteristics of a three-element vibrator-slot structure in a rectangular waveguide
publicationTitle: 2013 XVIIIth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: A problem of electromagnetic waves scattering and radiation by a structure consisting of two asymmetrical vibrators (monopoles) with variable surface impedance allocated in a rectangular waveguide and a narrow transverse slot cut in a broad wall of the waveguide is solved by the generalized method of induced electro-magneto-motive forces (EMMF). Wavelength dependencies of energy characteristics of the vibrator-slot structure for various dependencies of the surface impedance along the vibrators are presented.

articleTitle: Properties of oblique E-crosses for six-port measurements
publicationTitle: 2013 XVIIIth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: The problem of creating meter of complex reflection coefficient based on the electromagnetic approach using E-plane cross-shaped divider is studied. System of the integral equation describing scattering waves by the E-cross is solved. Rigorous electromagnetic model of direct and inverse problems of five-port measurements of complex reflection coefficient is derived. Frequency dependencies of model parameters are calculated. Properties of oblique crosses are investigated.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of exposure simulation results for a man, woman and child models
publicationTitle: 2013 XVIIIth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: The objective of this paper is to provide comparative analysis of EM exposure simulations for a man, woman and child models from virtual family. Our aim is to determine and compare peak values of SAR and temperature rise for child human model and compare them to results for the adult human models.

articleTitle: Amplification of electromagnetic radiation from 3D photonic crystals with quantum-dot gain material inclusions
publicationTitle: 2013 XVIIIth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: In this paper the scattering characteristics are calculated with the technique based on the volume integral equations for polarization currents. A study of electromagnetic field interaction with the 3D lattice dielectric structure involved defect layer and gain material is performed in this paper. An effect of gain material parameters on the amplification level of the structure is investigated. Distributions of the internal electric field intensity over the periodic cell are presented.

articleTitle: Bragg transformations in corrugated circular waveguides
publicationTitle: 2013 XVIIIth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: Circular waveguides with nonperiodical corrugation of wall and longitudinally gyrotropic filling are considered. The Krylov-Bogoliubov-Mitropolsky asymptotic method is used for solving boundary-value problem describing electromagnetic wave propagation in the close waveguiding structure. Mutual transformations of a wave modes propagating in such waveguides are investigated. Analytical solutions for some coupling coefficients are obtained. A variation of polarization parameters along longitudinal coordinate is analyzed. An influence of combination of a helical corrugation and longitudinal gyrotropy for mode and polarization transformation is investigated.

articleTitle: VLF propagation study in low ionosphare
publicationTitle: 2013 XVIIIth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: This article provides insight about signal amplitude variations of VLF electromagnetic waves by observing 10 communications radio stations at the same time. The amplitude variations of received VLF signals were compared with Solar flux number, geomagnetic KP-index and Earthquake data. The issues addressed include analysis of ionosphere parameters gathered for different geographical regions. The article especially reflects ongoing research within the Tbilisi State University Ionosphere Observatory.

articleTitle: Analysis of acoustic echo-signal from gas pipeline with long crack
publicationTitle: 2013 XVIIIth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: The scattering of plane non-stationary sound wave from a viscous gas-filled thin cylindrical shell weakened by long linear slit and submerged in ideal fluid is studied. The vibrations of elastic object are modeled on the base of Kirchhoff-Love thin shell-theory approximation. The solution of problem is obtained using the integral Fourier transform over time and in form of cylindrical harmonic series for spectral characteristics. The numerical analysis is carried out for the steel shell filled up methane and immersed in seawater. The scattering amplitudes, directivity patterns of the scattered field, and echo-signals from object are investigated with taking into consideration the orientation of slit on elastic shell surface. The obtained plots show the considerable influence of the slit and presence of gas in tube on diffraction process.

articleTitle: Experimental study of a transparent antenna
publicationTitle: 2013 XVIIIth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: The feasibility and usefulness of the transparent antenna built as a thin film, placed on a glass substrate and excited by a flat metal triangle, whose base is connected to the film base, which width is equal to its length, are confirmed experimentally. It is shown that the efficiency of such antenna is comparable with the monopole efficiency.

articleTitle: Interaction of normally incident SH-wave with an inhomogeneously strained elastic layer
publicationTitle: 2013 XVIIIth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: The problem of normally incident shear wave interaction with elastic layer, remaining in plane strain state, is considered. The problem is formulated within the model for small elastic disturbance propagation in non-homogeneously strained continuum. With the use the iterative method an analytical solution in zero and first approximations is obtained. The solution is applied to describe inhomogeneous transparency of the layer with residual stresses acting in it.

articleTitle: On the solvability of inverse transmission eigen-values problem for wave equation with a spherically-symmetric piecewise-constant wave speed
publicationTitle: 2013 XVIIIth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: The inverse spectral problem is examined in the paper for a spherically-symmetric piecewise-constant media, where transmission eigen-values are given as initial data. The problem is reduced to Hilbert-Riemann problems and a condition of uniqueness of the problem solution is established in a form, which is less strict in comparison with the inverse spectral problem for continuous wave speed. A constructive procedure for reconstruction of piecewise-constant wave speed is proposed starting form for all given complex transmission eigen-values including theirs multiplicities.

articleTitle: Analysis of beamforming algorithms for antijams
publicationTitle: 2013 XVIIIth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: Smart antennas are the key technology to suppress interferences and enhance the desired signal in strong interfering environment for satellites and GPS Signals. Smart/Adaptive arrays uses certain algorithms to process the incoming signal. A systematic comparison of the performance of different Adaptive Algorithms for beamforming for Smart Antenna System has been extensively studied in this research work including Least Mean Square (LMS) algorithm, Optimized-LMS algorithm and Recursive Least Squares (RLS).

articleTitle: Spherical antenna excited by a slot in an impedance end-wall of a rectangular waveguide
publicationTitle: 2013 XVIIIth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: The problem of electromagnetic waves radiation by a spherical antenna is solved using a rigorous self-consistent formulation. The antenna consists of a perfectly conducting sphere and a narrow slot cut in an impedance end-wall of a semi-infinite rectangular waveguide excited by a fundamental wave H<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sub>. An asymptotic solution of the integral equation for a magnetic current in the slot aperture was found by a generalized method of induced magnetomotive forces (MMF). The energy characteristics of the spherical antenna were investigated numerically for various sphere radiuses and values of surface impedance of the waveguide end-wall.

articleTitle: Determination of longitudinal waves in elastic media with distributed thin inclusions of low contrast
publicationTitle: 2013 XVIIIth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: An algorithm is proposed to study the effective velocities of longitudinal waves propagation in an unbounded isotropic elastic medium with a system of randomly distributed thin penny-shaped elastic inclusions of variable thickness. It is assumed that inclusions of low contrast, i. e. mechanical parameters of composites components differ unessentially in comparison with little relative thickness of inhomogeneities. The averaged dynamic parameters of such media are determined using the Foldy dispersive relation during the previous analysis of the problem of elastic waves scattering by the corresponding local scatterer.

Author Keywords: thin-walled elastic inclusions of low contrast

articleTitle: Miniaturization of microstrip patch antenna with multiband response for portable communication systems
publicationTitle: 2013 XVIIIth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: A novel technique for miniaturization of microstrip patch antenna is proposed for Portable and multifunctional Communication systems. Our proposed design consist of U-Shaped slot on fractal patch with first iteration and combination of L-Shape and U-Shape slots on the Ground plane. We also utilized shorting Pin between patch and ground plane. In this way we get smaller size antenna which is 89% smaller than the conventional antenna. The most interesting feature of our proposed design is that we are getting multiband response in the frequency range of 1–8GHZ having Gain in the range of 3.76dBi–5.32dBi and impedance bandwidth in the range of 3.1%–25% for desired bands. This type of smaller size antenna has applications in mobile phone for WiMaX, GSM 1800/ 3G/PCS, Bluetooth, GPS and for WLAN.

articleTitle: Resolution of inverse aperture synthesis in near-field and intermediate zone of the horn antenna radiation
publicationTitle: 2013 XVIIIth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: Unlike traditional approaches to inverse aperture synthesis by means of Fourier or Fresnel transform in dependence if the object is in far-field or intermediate zone, the space inverse filtering application is proposed. The inverse filter characteristics are obtained by means of calibration by scanning standard objects in form of metal strips. This approach allows us to compensate not only phase distortions but amplitude ones. The method has been tested experimentally for resolution of two metal strips separated by air gap. Corresponding estimates of resolution have been obtained. The results of improvement of radio images of cylinder are presented.

articleTitle: Solution of antenna inverse problem by penalty residual function and quasi-extent regularizator
publicationTitle: 2013 XVIIIth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: Solution of inverse problem of estimation of radiation sources is suggested. It is based on a non-linear optimization technique where objective function is built by penalty residual function and by spatial quasi-extent regularizator. The model of radiation sources is described by a set of the ideal Hertzian dipoles. The case, when dipoles are located along a straight line, which is parallel to measurement line of electric field, and when their electric moments are perpendicular to the measurement plane, is considered. Algorithm and numerical simulations with Gaussian additive noise are presented.

articleTitle: Sound radiation from aircraft during takeoff
publicationTitle: 2013 XVIIIth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: The problem of sound radiation from airplane during takeoff in wind conditions is considered. The aircraft engines are modeling as point sources moving in air with constant velocity under an angle to the plane interface of acoustic and solid elastic half-spaces. The solution of problem is obtained using the integral Fourier-transforms over time and space coordinates, and the stationary phase method. The numerical analysis of spatial-time distributions of sound pressure and sound pressure level is carried out for takeoff case of the twin-engine aircraft Boeing 777-300ER.

articleTitle: On the generalized solutions of initial-boundary problems for the wave equation, obtained by using Laguerre integral transformation
publicationTitle: 2013 XVIIIth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: It is shown that Fourier-Laguerre serie, which implements the inverse integral transform, can be interpreted as a generalized solution of the nonstationary problem.

articleTitle: Parallel implementation of Newton's method
publicationTitle: 2013 XVIIIth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: Parallel computing technologies for Newton's method realization are applied in the work, this allows significant reduction of the optimization problems solving time in the process of complex objects and systems computer-aided design and simulation, and the results are shown.

articleTitle: Stability of the solutions of problems with free phase
publicationTitle: 2013 XVIIIth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: The problem with free phase is considered. Stability of the approximate pseudosolutions with respect to the right part of the equation errors is proved.

articleTitle: Interaction of normally incident polarized light with strained layered structure “dielectric-metal”
publicationTitle: 2013 XVIIIth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: Reflection of normally incident polarized light by a strained layered structure “dielectric-metal”, transmission of the light wave through the structure and changing its polarization state are considered in the paper. Possibilities of application of the obtained results for the non-destructive determination of strain-stressed state for dielectric solids are discussed.

articleTitle: Human exposure simulation in big scenarios using MAS
publicationTitle: 2013 XVIIIth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: A solution approach to the diffraction problem for human body inside of a semi-open geometry is described in this paper.

articleTitle: Scattering of H-polarized electromagnetic wave by grooved dihedral wedge co-axially coupled with dielectric covered metal slotted cylinder
publicationTitle: 2013 XVIIIth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: Scattering of electromagnetic wave is considered for a composite structure consisting of a conducting grooved dihedral wedge that is co-axially coupled with a slotted cylinder covered with dielectric. The boundary-value method is employed using completeness property of the angular functions in the respective intervals. Problem is reduced to solution of system of algebraic equations of second kind for the unknown coefficients of Fourier expansion of scattered field. Analytical solution is obtained for certain values of cylinder slot-width and electrical radius of cylinder. Scattered far-field and backscatter radar cross section (BRCS) of the structure are formulated.

articleTitle: Development of strong motion acceleration and VLF electromagnetic detectors network in Georgia
publicationTitle: 2013 XVIIIth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: This article provides insight about development creating and implantation of strong motion accelerometer and VLF electromagnetic detectors network for investigation of seismic activities in different geographical regions of Georgia, the state and physical characteristics of low ionosphere. The obtained data will be automatically transferred and collected in data center in Tbilisi State University.

articleTitle: Asymptotic solution for bragg mode conversion in corrugated rectangular waveguide
publicationTitle: 2013 XVIIIth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: Rectangular waveguides with nonperiodical corrugation of wall are considered. The Krylov-Bogoliubov-Mitropolsky asymptotic method is used for solving boundary-value problem describing electromagnetic wave propagation in the close waveguiding structure. Mutual transformations of a wave modes propagating in such waveguides are investigated. Analytical solutions for some coupling coefficients are obtained.

articleTitle: Computer simulation of nanoplasmonic antennas
publicationTitle: 2013 XVIIIth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: Plasmoinc structures, in particularly plasmonic nano antennas are very attractive in many applications. From other side numerical simulations of plasmonic structures are very demanding and expensive in terms of memory and CPU time, making the selection of a suitable numerical method for the field computation important. The numerical problems are caused because optical nanostructures based on metal parts exhibit strong material dispersion, loss, and plasmon-polariton effects that require a very accurate numerical simulation. We use new design concepts based on 3D simulations for nanoplasmonic antenna structures by using MAS, which is the semi-analytic Maxwell solver for computational electrodynamics in the frequency domain and can handle various electromagnetic (EM) problems on the personal computers while.

articleTitle: A reduced RCS ultra wide band antenna with eye geometry
publicationTitle: 2013 XVIIIth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: In this study, an eye shaped ultra wide band (UWB) antenna which radiates at 2.5-18 GHz is designed. The designed antenna covering the entire band assigned for the UWB application, which is more than 151%. The RCS (radar cross section) of the designed antenna is reduced by modifying the physical structure. RCS of the antenna is reduced up to 15 dB. The proposed antenna is fabricated and the experimental results of the radiation performances are in a good agreement with the simulation results.

articleTitle: Time-domain dipole fields in acoustics and electromagnetics
publicationTitle: 2013 XVIIIth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: The ultrawideband (UWB) radio technique presents a challenge not just for technology. The UWB carrier-free pulses act at a close distance, their electromagnetic fields being very different from classic monochromatic plane waves. The author proposes to adapt a time-domain approach to analysis of broadband spherical fields, both acoustic and electromagnetic, in fundamental cases of quasi-point physical sources.

articleTitle: Autocollimation of gaussian beam reflected by nonrectangular reflect array
publicationTitle: 2013 XVIIIth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: This paper investigates dispersion of three-dimensional Gaussian wave beam on a two-dimensional periodical array of short-circuited waveguides with beveled (nonrectangular) grid in the autocollimation mode. Correlation of reflection rates in terms of power and the length of short-circuited waveguides has been estimated for specular and non-specular beams. Relation of reflected beams directional pattern in the far field to the array and incident beam parameters has been investigated. Three-dimensional directional patterns have been designed in terms of the power of specular and non-specular beams in the far field. Energy characteristics and three-dimensional directional patterns have been obtained for the non-specular beam in the far field.

articleTitle: On the zeros of Kummer function: Basic properties and their application in the theory of the azimuthally magnetized circular ferrite waveguide
publicationTitle: 2013 XVIIIth International Seminar/Workshop on Direct and Inverse Problems of Electromagnetic and Acoustic Wave Theory (DIPED)
abstract: A numerical evaluation of the first several purely imaginary (real) zeros ζ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k,n</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(c)</sup> in x, resp. in z (ζ̂<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k̂,n̂</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(c)</sup> in x̂) of the complex (real) Kummer confluent hypergeometric function Φ(a,c;x), [Φ(â,ĉ;x̂)] is performed, assuming a = c / 2 - jk, c = 1 and c = 3, x = jz, k, z - real, -∞ <; k <; +∞, z > 0 (â = ĉ/2 + k̂, ĉ=1 and ĉ = 3, k̂, x̂ - real, -∞ <; k̂ <; -ĉ / 2, x̂ > 0). The results of analysis are presented in a tabular form, depending on the imaginary part k of parameter a of Φ̂̂(a,c; x) [on the addition k̂ in parameter â of Φ̂(â,ĉ;x̂)]. Momentous characteristics of quantities studied, concerning the number n (n̂) of zeros of the complex (real) function, their specification and their behaviour in case k → -∞ (k̂→-∞), are established. Some related numbers, called L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>(c,n) [L̂<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>(ĉ,n̂)] ones and their features, are also considered. The employment of zeros ζ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k,n</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(c)</sup> and ζ̂<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k̂,n̂</sub><sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(ĉ)</sup>, and of the derivative of them quantities L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>(c,n) and L̂<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>(ĉ,n̂) in the theory of waveguides, is discussed, as well.
